---
title: "Call Dictionary"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)
calls <- read.csv("data/calls.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
if (!"context" %in% names(calls)) calls$context <- ""
```

A reference guide to Western Screech-Owl calls, with multiple recorded examples of each. Click play to listen.

```{r entries, results='asis'}
call_types <- unique(calls$call_type)

for (ct in call_types) {
  rows <- calls[calls$call_type == ct, , drop = FALSE]

  cat('<div class="call-type">\n')
  cat('<h2>', htmltools::htmlEscape(ct), '</h2>\n', sep = "")

  descriptions <- rows$description[!is.na(rows$description) & nchar(trimws(rows$description)) > 0]
  if (length(descriptions) > 0) {
    cat('<p class="call-type-description">', htmltools::htmlEscape(descriptions[1]), '</p>\n', sep = "")
  }

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(rows))) {
    row <- rows[i, ]
    cat('<div class="call-example">\n')

    meta_bits <- c(row$context, row$location, row$date)
    meta_bits <- meta_bits[!is.na(meta_bits) & nchar(trimws(meta_bits)) > 0]
    if (length(meta_bits) > 0) {
      cat('<p class="call-meta">', htmltools::htmlEscape(paste(meta_bits, collapse = " · ")), '</p>\n', sep = "")
    }

    spectro_path <- file.path("www/spectrograms", row$spectrogram_file)
    if (file.exists(spectro_path)) {
      cat('<img class="spectrogram" src="', spectro_path, '" alt="Spectrogram of ',
          htmltools::htmlEscape(ct), '">\n', sep = "")
    }

    audio_path <- file.path("www/audio", row$audio_file)
    if (file.exists(audio_path)) {
      cat('<audio controls preload="none" src="', audio_path, '"></audio>\n', sep = "")
    }

    cat('</div>\n')
  }

  cat('</div>\n')
}
```
